name: Panu Pasanen
headline: CEO & Founder, One Click LCA | The sustainability platform for construction & manufacturing
summary:
Life Cycle Assessment and Carbon expert and entrepreneur and advocate for industrial decarbonisation.

Used in 170+ countries, One Click LCA is the leading end-to-end sustainability platform for construction and manufacturing. The AI-powered software decarbonizes and drives sustainability across the construction value chain — with scientific, easy-to-use, automated life-cycle assessment (LCA) and environmental product declarations (EPDs) to calculate and reduce the environmental impacts of building, infrastructure, and renovation. Learn more at: oneclicklca.com

We're hiring in Europe and globally - currently available roles at https://careers.oneclicklca.com/.

positions.title: CEO & Decarbonization Evangelist
positions.description:
One Click LCA is the global leader in life-cycle assessment software, used in 170+ countries.

One Click LCA is unique in several ways:
- It's easy to use, designed for efficiency, flexibility and transparency.
- It's global. It integrates local data from 60 countries and is available in nine languages.
- It's compliant. It supports 100+ different certifications and regulations (including LEED & BREEAM) 
- It's integrated to 20+ software, including Autodesk Revit, IES-VE, Solibri, DesignBuilder etc.
- It allows you to work in schematic design with Carbon Designer to reduce carbon early on
- It gives a full picture. One Click LCA has modules for LCA, LCC, EPDs, civil works and circular economy.

Read more at www.oneclicklca.com

company.name: One Click LCA
company.tagline: The sustainability platform for construction & manufacturing
company.description:
Used in 170+ countries, One Click LCA is the leading end-to-end sustainability platform for construction and manufacturing. 

The AI-powered software decarbonizes and drives sustainability across the construction value chain with scientific, easy-to-use, automated life-cycle assessment (LCA) and environmental product declarations (EPDs) to calculate and reduce the environmental impacts of building, infrastructure, and renovation projects and products. The platform also allows assessment of circularity, life-cycle cost, and biodiversity. One Click LCA is used by blue-chip enterprises like AECOM, Arcadis, Foster+Partners, WSP, ArcelorMittal, Geberit, and Saint-Gobain, among others. 

It offers a unique global database with +300,000 LCA datasets; supports +80 standards and certifications, including LEED, BREEAM, GRESB and other national regulations; and seamlessly integrates with +20 of the most widely used BIM software tools, including Autodesk Revit®, Tekla Structures® and Bentley iTwin®. 

One Click LCA was founded in Helsinki, Finland in 2001, with a team of +200 people on all continents. Learn more at: oneclicklca.com
